title: Understanding the True Model
text: Think about what the true model represents in the context of the data generation process. How does the parameter $$\theta_{star}$$ relate to the design matrix X and the response vector Y?

title: Exploring the Role of $$\theta_{star}$$
text: Consider the role of $$\theta_{star}$$ in the equation $$Y_i=\operatorname{f_{\theta,star}}\left(X_i\right)+\epsilon_i$$. Is $$\theta_{star}$$ a parameter that changes with each observation, or is it a fixed parameter for the entire dataset?
